messages:
anya: Heads-up: were launching a 4-arm canary tomorrow for mistral-x2 (7B). Two quant configs + kv-cache variant + prod-fallback. Need promptset prep, dedupe, golden labeling, and labeler scheduling. Goal: catch regressions vs prod on our holdout + benchmark suite.

sam: Copy. How big is the seed?

anya: Target: 6k eval dialogs (1.5k per arm) and a 500-example golden set for edge/manual review (longctx, conversations with structured outputs).

marta: We can staff it: 4 labelers for 3 days. Need an updated golden guide calling out new failure cases.

anya: Callouts for the guide: long-prefetch hallucination, enum-order flips, instruction-following drifts, truncation/paraphrase deltas across quants. Add check: reproducible prompt, exact model+quant tag, tokenizer version, seed id, dedupe fingerprint.

leo: Ill run fuzzy-dedupe + deid before labelers touch anything. Please run this on generation output. Example command: 

```
./tools/dedupe --input canary_seed.ndjson --threshold 0.84 --out canary_dedupe_report.json
```

leo: Ill also produce a fingerprint map and a small CSV of candidate dupes for the labelers to skip.

sam: Ill generate the 6k tonight. Plan: identical prompts across arms, capture outputs with model/quant metadata, tokenization and latency stats. Upload path: s3://redwood-canaries/mistral-x2/1711112229/manifest.json

labeler-bot: Created task LBL-4551: "Mistral-x2 canary golden labeling" assigned to @marta + team.

marta: Got LBL-4551. Please upload the post-dedupe 500 golden examples and the guide. Well do the 500 first, then sample 200 examples per arm for adjudication.

anya: Canary routing config (low sample_rate, balanced arms):

```
canary:
  sample_rate: 0.005
  arms:
    - name: int8-baseline
      weight: 0.25
    - name: int4-optim
      weight: 0.25
    - name: int8-kvcache
      weight: 0.25
    - name: prod-fallback
      weight: 0.25
```

leo: Quick metric smoke: embedding-sim recall vs prod, flag if drop > 5%. Ill push the metric job and a delta.csv of examples that changed (truncation/paraphrase/token-drop).

sam: ETA: generation + metadata by 06:00 PT. Will post manifest and s3 path here when done.

anya: Please include tokenizer version (tokenizer-v2.1), generation seed, and exact model artifact id in metadata. Export dedupe report + the delta CSV for labelers. Upload guide & artifacts to internal drive: https://drive.redwood/inference/canary/mistral-x2/1711112229 (internal). Canary standup: tomorrow 10:30 PT. :rocket:

marta: :thumbsup: team standing by to start labels once seed lands and dedupe completes.

leo: small note: add latency p50/p95 per arm to manifest so we can triage perf-quality tradeoffs quickly.

anya: Good call. Thanks everyone.
